calls.claim: The 2026-08-25 settlement, which the board carries at +107B of net new cash (the board's own projection), lands within $10.7B of that figure once Treasury has announced it.
calls.rule: hit if next week's supply table shows that date announced with Treasury's amount and within tolerance, miss if it is announced and outside; open if the row is still projected or its amount is still TBA (a TBA fill is the desk's own estimate and is never graded as announced)

calls.claim: SRF take-up stays under $1B on every session of the week, which is to say it stays below the de minimis line.
calls.expected: under $1B; the trailing twenty session maximum today is $0.10B
calls.rule: hit if next week's board shows a twenty session maximum take-up under the threshold, miss if any session prints at or above it

calls.claim: Reserves print near $3,038B on next week's H.4.1, the base leg's week one level.
calls.expected: $3,038B, tolerance $25B (the width of the desk's own fast to slow bracket at week one, floored at $25B)
calls.rule: hit if next week's board carries current reserves within tolerance of the target, miss otherwise

calls.claim: The composite reads between 43.2 and 47.9 on next week's board.
calls.expected: 43.2 to 47.9, from 46.0 today; the band is the board's own Monte Carlo p10 to p90 at 5 sessions, seeded fixed so the band is reproducible
calls.rule: hit if next week's composite prints inside the band, miss otherwise

calls.claim: The desk's continuous reserve demand fit stays inside the NY Fed's published 68% band.
calls.expected: inside [-0.44, -0.09]bp per one percent of reserves; the desk reads -0.30bp today
calls.rule: hit if next week's nowcast still reports the same side of their band, miss if it flips; open if either fit is dark
